title: LambdaOutputUpdate

allOf.description:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the destination Amazon Lambda function.

To specify an earlier version of the Lambda function than the latest, include the Lambda function version in the Lambda function ARN. For more information about Lambda ARNs, see Example ARNs: Amazon Lambda

description: When you update an SQL-based Kinesis Data Analytics application's output configuration using the UpdateApplication operation, provides information about an Amazon Lambda function that is configured as the destination.
